entries.name: eigenlabs/heesch
entries.title: Heesch
entries.validationDesign: Validate geometric witnesses and non-tiling evidence from a fixed census or checked UNSAT certificate; rank completed coronas plus a bounded partial-coverage term.
entries.scientificInterpretation: Completed coronas with non-tiling evidence support a mathematical bound. Partial coverage is a local search objective, not a fractional Heesch number or proof-completion probability.
entries.supportCaveat: A small census-only witness adaptation could fit the data profile. The full proof workflow, formats, native checkers and record-scale budgets do not.
